- **Story:** As Riley, a mob adopting mob-defaults for a new project, I want the default documentation to read as timeless rules with no calendar dates, so that I can apply each rule as written without working out which dated item is stale.
- **Acceptance criteria (at most 3, each failing on partial work):**
  1. No calendar dates in mob-defaults markdown, enforced by a check that fails on date patterns; any allow-listed date carries a reason. ZOMBIES to be written by QA at ready.
  2. Each dated rule keeps its meaning with the date removed (a "since X" is reworded timelessly), and links and anchors still resolve. ZOMBIES to be written by QA at ready.
  3. A new dated line in the template or the repo's own agreement fails the check. ZOMBIES to be written by QA at ready.
- **Enables:** none
